description: Agent framework telemetry from Application Insights. Agents are identified by the OpenTelemetry agent name or id, so agents that run on local inferencing or any non-Azure provider appear alongside Azure hosted ones. Token counts come from OpenTelemetry. Cost comes from the source that actually bills the call: GitHub reports the AI credits it charged, and Azure usage is priced from the hub price sheet. Anything that cannot be priced is named in Costing coverage rather than shown as zero.

panels.description: Key performance indicators for agent operations including total operations executed, token consumption (input and output), and average response time across all agents.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let agentNames = dynamic([$agentName]);
dependencies 
| where name contains "invoke_agent"
| extend agent_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| where isnotempty(agent_name)
| where array_length(agentNames) > 0
| where agent_name in (agentNames)
| extend 
    input_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
    output_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| summarize 
    ['Total Operations'] = count(),
    ['Total Input Tokens'] = sum(input_tokens),
    ['Total Output Tokens'] = sum(output_tokens),
    ['Avg Response Time'] = round(avg(duration) / 1000, 2)

panels.title: Summary Statistics

panels.description: Stacked time series chart showing input and output token usage trends over time, helping monitor AI model consumption and associated costs.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let agentNames = dynamic([$agentName]);
dependencies 
| where name contains "invoke_agent"
| extend agent_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| where isnotempty(agent_name)
| where array_length(agentNames) > 0
| where agent_name in (agentNames)
| extend 
    input_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
    output_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| summarize 
    ['Input Tokens'] = sum(input_tokens),
    ['Output Tokens'] = sum(output_tokens)
    by bin(timestamp, $__interval)

panels.title: Token Consumption Over Time

panels.description: Donut chart showing the distribution of total token consumption (input + output) across different agents, helping identify which agents consume the most resources.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let agentNames = dynamic([$agentName]);
dependencies 
| where name contains "invoke_agent"
| extend agent_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| where isnotempty(agent_name)
| where array_length(agentNames) > 0
| where agent_name in (agentNames)
| extend 
    input_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
    output_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| summarize

    by agent_name

panels.title: Token Usage by Agent

panels.description: Cost by day, kept apart by where each number came from. GitHub reports the AI credits it charged and Azure usage is priced from the hub price sheet, so the two bases are shown as separate series and never added together.
panels.title: Daily token cost
Token economics by agent and model
panels.description: Tokens are always shown. Cost basis states where a number came from, or why there is none. GitHub rows carry the AI credits GitHub reported; Azure rows are priced from the hub price sheet.

panels.title: Costing coverage
panels.description: Calls, tokens and cost by basis, so a gap reads as a gap rather than as zero cost. AI credits are what GitHub reported it charged, before any plan allowance is applied, so the USD column is a value of consumption rather than an invoiced amount.
Percentage of input tokens served from cache across LLM chat calls (gen_ai.operation.name == 'chat'). Cached input is ~1/10 the price of uncached, so a high hit rate directly reduces spend.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| extend op_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"])
| where op_name == "chat"
| extend in_tok = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
         cache_tok = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens"])
| summarize cache_hit_pct = round(sum(cache_tok) * 100.0 / sum(in_tok), 1)

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate (chat)

panels.description: Total input tokens served from prompt cache. Equivalent to ~90% of these tokens' uncached cost saved.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| extend op_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"])
| where op_name == "chat"
| extend cache_tok = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens"])
| summarize ['Tokens From Cache'] = sum(cache_tok)

panels.title: Tokens From Cache (chat)

panels.description: Distribution of LLM chat finish reasons. Common values: tool_calls (multi-step agent step), stop (completion), length (hit max_tokens), content_filter (safety).

dependencies
| extend op_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]),
         finish = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.finish_reasons"])
| where op_name == "chat"
| where isnotempty(finish)
| summarize call_count = count() by finish

panels.title: Chat Finish Reasons

panels.description: p95 latency of LLM chat calls broken out by gen_ai.response.model. Surfaces silent model routing and per-model latency drift.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| extend op_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]),
         model = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"])
| where op_name == "chat"
| extend model = iff(isempty(model), "(unknown)", model)
| summarize p95_ms = percentile(duration, 95) by bin(timestamp, $__interval), model

panels.title: Chat p95 Latency by Model

panels.description: Most-used tools by call count, with success rate and latency. Sortable.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| extend op_name = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.operation.name"]),
         tool = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.tool.name"])

list.query:
let agentSpans = materialize(dependencies
| where name has 'invoke_agent' or tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']) in ('chat', 'execute_tool')
| extend operation = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.operation.name']),
    agentId = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.id']),
    agentName = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.agent.name']),
    provider = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.provider.name'])
// Identity never depends on a provider specific field. Agents without an id or a
// name collapse into one bucket per service, so the roster cannot grow a row per span.
| extend agentKey = case(isnotempty(agentId), strcat(cloud_RoleName, '|', agentId),
        isnotempty(agentName), strcat(cloud_RoleName, '|', agentName),
        strcat(cloud_RoleName, '|(unidentified)')),
    agentLabel = case(isnotempty(agentName), agentName,
        isnotempty(agentId), agentId,
        strcat(cloud_RoleName, ' (unidentified agents)')));
let agentUsage = materialize(agentSpans
| where operation == 'chat'
| extend model = tostring(coalesce(customDimensions['gen_ai.response.model'], customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model'])),
    inputTokens = tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']),
    outputTokens = tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']),
    cacheReadTokens = coalesce(tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']), tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cached_tokens']), long(0)),
    cacheWriteTokens = coalesce(tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens']), tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens']), long(0))
| extend modelKey = normalizeModel(model),
    providerLabel = iff(isempty(provider), '(provider not reported)', provider)
// Only usage billed through Azure can be priced from the hub price sheet. The
// OpenTelemetry enum defines the first two; Microsoft Foundry instrumentation also
// emits the Foundry values, which are observed live, so both spellings are accepted.
// GitHub Copilot bills on its own meter and reports its own charge, so it is priced
// from its own telemetry below rather than from this price sheet.
| extend billableInput = coalesce(inputTokens, long(0)) - cacheReadTokens - cacheWriteTokens,
    azureRated = provider in~ ('azure.ai.openai', 'azure.ai.inference', 'azure.ai.foundry', 'microsoft.foundry'),
    claudeModel = modelKey has 'claude'
// GitHub Copilot reports what it charged. github.copilot.nano_aiu is GitHub AI credit
// consumption in nano units, already resolved for the model, for the cache split and
// for the long context tier, so it is read rather than rebuilt from a rate table.
// Checked against the published GitHub rates over 4352 calls: 4216 agreed exactly and
// the rest were long context calls where the reported value carried the higher tier
// that a default tier calculation misses. github.copilot.cost is the legacy premium
// request multiplier, not an amount of money, so it is deliberately unused.
| extend ghCredits = todouble(customDimensions['github.copilot.nano_aiu']) / 1000000000.0
| extend ghCredits = iff(provider =~ 'github' and isnotnull(ghCredits)
        and not(isnan(ghCredits)) and not(isinf(ghCredits)) and ghCredits >= 0.0,
    ghCredits, real(null))
| extend rates = price[modelKey]
| extend rateInput = todouble(rates.i), rateCacheRead = todouble(rates.cr),
    rateCacheWrite = todouble(rates.cw), rateOutput = todouble(rates.o)
// A rate is required only for a token kind that was actually used.
| extend missingRate = (billableInput > 0 and isnull(rateInput))
    or (cacheReadTokens > 0 and isnull(rateCacheRead))
    or (cacheWriteTokens > 0 and isnull(rateCacheWrite))
    or (coalesce(outputTokens, long(0)) > 0 and isnull(rateOutput))
// A broken usage counter is reported ahead of any price, so a gap in the telemetry is
// never hidden behind a cost that happens to be available.
| extend costingState = case(
    isnull(inputTokens) and isnull(outputTokens), 'Usage counters missing',
    billableInput < 0, 'Usage counters inconsistent',
    isnotnull(ghCredits), 'Reported by GitHub in AI credits',
    provider =~ 'github', 'GitHub reported no charge for the call',
    not(azureRated), 'No price source for this provider',
    claudeModel, 'Billed as Claude consumption units',
    not(pricesLoaded), 'Price sheet unavailable',
    set_has_element(ambiguousModels, modelKey), 'Meter match ambiguous',
    isnull(rates), 'No matching token meter',
    missingRate, 'Rate missing for a used token kind',
    'Priced from the Azure price sheet')
// The two sources stay apart. Azure cost carries the price sheet currency and GitHub
// credits are converted where they are displayed, so neither is folded into the other.
| extend aiCredits = iff(costingState == 'Reported by GitHub in AI credits', ghCredits, real(null)),
    azureCost = iff(costingState == 'Priced from the Azure price sheet',
        (billableInput * coalesce(rateInput, 0.0)
            + cacheReadTokens * coalesce(rateCacheRead, 0.0)
            + cacheWriteTokens * coalesce(rateCacheWrite, 0.0)
            + coalesce(outputTokens, long(0)) * coalesce(rateOutput, 0.0)) / 1000000.0,
        real(null)));

// the rest were long context calls where the reported value carried the higher tier
// that a default tier calculation misses. github.copilot.cost is the legacy premium
// request multiplier, not an amount of money, so it is deliberately unused.
| extend ghCredits = todouble(customDimensions['github.copilot.nano_aiu']) / 1000000000.0
| extend ghCredits = iff(provider =~ 'github' and isnotnull(ghCredits)
        and not(isnan(ghCredits)) and not(isinf(ghCredits)) and ghCredits >= 0.0,
    ghCredits, real(null))
| extend rates = price[modelKey]
| extend rateInput = todouble(rates.i), rateCacheRead = todouble(rates.cr),
    rateCacheWrite = todouble(rates.cw), rateOutput = todouble(rates.o)
// A rate is required only for a token kind that was actually used.
| extend missingRate = (billableInput > 0 and isnull(rateInput))
    or (cacheReadTokens > 0 and isnull(rateCacheRead))
    or (cacheWriteTokens > 0 and isnull(rateCacheWrite))
    or (coalesce(outputTokens, long(0)) > 0 and isnull(rateOutput))
// A broken usage counter is reported ahead of any price, so a gap in the telemetry is
// never hidden behind a cost that happens to be available.
| extend costingState = case(
    isnull(inputTokens) and isnull(outputTokens), 'Usage counters missing',
    billableInput < 0, 'Usage counters inconsistent',
    isnotnull(ghCredits), 'Reported by GitHub in AI credits',
    provider =~ 'github', 'GitHub reported no charge for the call',
    not(azureRated), 'No price source for this provider',
    claudeModel, 'Billed as Claude consumption units',
    not(pricesLoaded), 'Price sheet unavailable',
    set_has_element(ambiguousModels, modelKey), 'Meter match ambiguous',
    isnull(rates), 'No matching token meter',
    missingRate, 'Rate missing for a used token kind',
    'Priced from the Azure price sheet')
// The two sources stay apart. Azure cost carries the price sheet currency and GitHub
// credits are converted where they are displayed, so neither is folded into the other.
| extend aiCredits = iff(costingState == 'Reported by GitHub in AI credits', ghCredits, real(null)),
    azureCost = iff(costingState == 'Priced from the Azure price sheet',
        (billableInput * coalesce(rateInput, 0.0)
            + cacheReadTokens * coalesce(rateCacheRead, 0.0)
            + cacheWriteTokens * coalesce(rateCacheWrite, 0.0)
            + coalesce(outputTokens, long(0)) * coalesce(rateOutput, 0.0)) / 1000000.0,
        real(null)));
